name: hablator-monorepo
description: Task runner for the hablator monorepo (backend/ + frontend/). Not a real Node package — just scripts.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix frontend install && npm run be:sync
scripts.be:run: cd backend && uv run poe run
scripts.be:check: cd backend && uv run poe check
scripts.be:test: cd backend && uv run poe test
scripts.check: npm run be:check && npm run fe:check && npm run fe:build
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && uv run poe migrate
scripts.db:generate: cd backend && uv run poe migrate:generate
